summary.en: A single-file Space Invaders at roughly 4KB gzipped — minimalism taken to its logical extreme.
summary.zh: gzip 后仅约 4KB 的单文件太空侵略者，极致压缩的极限挑战作品。

description.en: Plays just like the arcade original, with every line of logic, rendering and sound crammed into one minified JS file.
description.zh: 玩法同经典太空侵略者，全部逻辑、图形绘制、音效都在一个压缩后的 JS 文件里完成。

howto.en: Left/right arrows to move, space to shoot.

tip.en: Slap a one-line badge on the page — 'this game is just 4KB gzipped'. Instant loading is a real, tangible edge on weak connections and in price-sensitive markets.
tip.zh: 可在页面加一行「本游戏 gzip 后仅 4KB」的标签，秒开体验在弱网/下沉市场是实打实的优势。
